about: Milk and Cookies with Santa is a Parker Recreation holiday event.
It is part of the Kids' Zone December lineup for ages 3 to 6.
The date is Sunday, December 13, 2026.
The first session runs 12:45 to 1:45 PM.
The second session runs 2:15 to 3:15 PM.
It takes place at the Parker Fieldhouse, 18700 E Plaza Dr.
Parker residents pay $16 per child.
Non-residents pay $18 per child.
Space is limited, so Parker Recreation asks families to register early.
Kids enjoy milk, cookies and a special visit from Santa.
The event is held indoors.
Registration goes through Parker Recreation.
